function.description: Run analysis Python for visualization or SQL-unsupported statistics. Explain why outside SQL. Globals: db.query(sql, parameters=[]), db.executemany(sql, parameter_sets), db.executescript(sql), db.rows(result), db.frame(result). function.name: dacomp_query_db
